item.title: Core Keeper Co-op Guide — Multiplayer Scaling, Division of Labour and Shared Progress
item.description: Core Keeper is built for the couch-cave loop: three friends, one Core, nobody agreeing on where the farm goes. This co-op guide covers what multiplayer actually changes mechanically (spawns, boss health, save ownership), what stays personal, and how to split roles so your party moves faster than two solo players would. What co-op changes — and what it doesn’t Verified multiplayer rules from the combat mechanics: Mechanic Single player In co-op Regular mob health / damage Base values Unchanged — no inflation Local ambient spawn rate 1× around you ~2× with two players standing together — everyone triggers their own spawns Boss health Base Scales up by player count, with a different multiplier per boss Hard mode tag Fixed at world creation Same for everyone; the tag lives in the world save Seasonal / calendar settings Your calendar Host’s (or server’s) setting takes priority for everyone NPCs, rooms, seasonal merchant In your world In the host’s world — everyone trades there The practical surprise is spawn rate, not boss numbers: splitting up across the map is safer than travelling together, because clustered players feel like a spotlight drawing mobs from every tunnel.

item.title: Core Keeper Greenhouse Guide — Crop Layout, Harvest Chance and Golden Crop Profit
item.description: A greenhouse is where Core Keeper shifts from “scavenge food” to “manufacture buffs.” This advanced guide covers the growth cycle, picking crops by ground type, stacking harvest chance for throughput, and laying out plots so watering never becomes a chore. The 10-minute growth cycle Once you water a seed, the timer runs on its own — you can leave and come back: Stage Time Watered seed → sprout 2 minutes Sprout → pre-harvest 4 minutes Pre-harvest → harvestable 4 minutes Every manual harvest grants gardening experience.

item.title: Core Keeper NPC and Villager Guide — Room Requirements, Merchants and Move-in Rules
item.description: Core Keeper’s towns don’t grow by themselves: every settled resident moves in because you built the right room, put the right item in it, and walked away long enough for them to notice. This NPC guide covers the verified room system, how merchants and seasonal visitors work, and where to find trader cells in the wild.
